questions.question: In Ezekiel's prophecy, what did God say Gog of Magog would devise in his mind on the day he came against Israel?
God told Ezekiel that Gog would come against His people Israel out of the far south. True or false?
In Ezekiel's prophecy, why did God say He would bring Gog against His land?

answers.text: So the nations may know Him
So Gog's own people are punished
So Israel's army can be tested
